svg.text: NIC-Strelka — the board's parts and their nets, from BOARD.md (not a schematic)

Flat: every pin ends in its net's name; a red cross is a pin left unconnected. One board, two fittings: (B) and "the Belka alone" mark the parts Povodok goes without. A buck and a charger set by resistors; U11, the switch, on by magnet A; the cell on J2. Drawn by board/nets.py.
U1 — Fanstel BM20F or WM02C20C, the nRF54LM20A module
U2 — onsemi NCP361SNT1G, the USB supply's guard
U10 — TI TPS62933, the buck, 3,93 V from the cable
U3 — TI BQ25170, the charger, linear; 3,50 V, 300 mA by resistors
U4 — Analog Devices MAX17055, the fuel gauge
U11 — TI LM66200, two ideal diodes to SYS; off while ON is high
U6 — TI TPS7A2030, LDO 3,0 V, +3V0_SD — the Belka alone
U7 — TDK ICM-42686-P or ICM-42688-P — the Belka alone
J3 — Megastar ZX-TF-281.6J, the microSD slot — the Belka alone
VBUS — the inlet, and the buck's input
5-pin magnetic contact: 1 VBUS · 2 D+ · 3 GND · 4 D− · 5 VBUS
VBUCK — the buck's output, the charger's input
BATT− — the cell's minus, the gauge's side
SYS — the ideal diodes' output, the LDOs' input
1 µF 50 V 0805, at the LDOs' inputs
ON — the board's switch: on by magnet A, held by the processor
1 MΩ 1 % 0402 — ON held high, the board off
DRV5032ZE, magnet A: 1 VCC BAT · 2 OUT · 3 GND
BAT54, Schottky: magnet A pulls ON down
BSS138, D ON, S GND, G HOLD — the hold
100 nF 0402 — Q1 held through a reset
BSS138, D HALL_A, S MAG_A, G +3V0 — the reading
BSS138, D ON, S GND, G VBUCK — Povodok alone
DRV5032ZE, magnet B: 1 VCC +3V0 · 2 OUT · 3 GND
